title: Creamy Mushroom Fettuccine
steps:
Boil the pasta.
Save a cup of
pasta water

Brown mushrooms in butter.
Add shallot, garlic,
thyme for 1 minute

Cream + peas, 3 min.
Stir in parmesan,
toss with the pasta
vo: Pasta night, ready in about thirty minutes.
You need fettuccine, mushrooms, heavy cream, parmesan, garlic, a shallot and frozen peas.
Boil the fettuccine, and save a cup of the pasta water before you drain it.
Brown the mushrooms in butter, then add the shallot, garlic and thyme for one minute.
Pour in the cream and peas, simmer three minutes, stir in the parmesan, and toss it all with the pasta.
